decisions.question: This PR touches billing, plans, credits or pricing, which no agent checks: will you review that part yourself before it merges?
options: Review that part yourself before it merges
Let Author merge it without that review
decisions.recommendation: Review that part yourself; the link opens where it starts.
decisions.why: Money rules are outside what these agents check, so only a person can clear them.

flagged.label: a message sent to people (SMS, email, push)

cleared.why: The send call is the existing reminder path; only the text changes and it carries no new recipient.
